notes: Tests exercise the real code paths: mail_test.go drives Read/Notify/SendNow/Deliver against a fake SMTP listener and an in-memory ledger; httpapi/mail_test.go hits validateSettingValue, FromValues.Validate and the adminSendTestMail handler; web mail.test.ts covers mailProblem/mailSummary. go build/vet/test for mail, httpapi, generation, settings pass; web tsc and vitest pass.

server/cmd/ptium/main.go: mailer.Wait() is never called on shutdown, so a delivery in flight when the process stops is cut off and stays 'queued' in mail_deliveries forever (service.go comment says shutdown wants Wait). Minor operational gap, not a correctness fault for requests.

server/internal/mail/mail.go:134 Deliver returns client.Quit()'s error even after the relay accepted DATA (250); a relay that drops the connection at QUIT is recorded as failed and deliver() retries, producing a duplicate mail. Edge case only.
server/internal/mail/service.go:159 the retry loop also retries ErrInvalid (e.g. relay without STARTTLS while starttls is demanded) — harmless, just a wasted second attempt.

server/internal/httpapi/handlers_admin.go:431 mail.smtp_host rejects ':' so a bare IPv6 literal cannot be used as the relay host; documented as 'host name or address'. Acceptable for the stated internal-relay use.

Shared-comment notification is bounded by store.MaximumComments per deck, so an unauthenticated link holder cannot mail-bomb the owner indefinitely, but each comment up to the cap does spawn a mail goroutine.

web/src/api/client.ts:1516 and web/src/types.ts:318 — the new declarations were inserted between an existing doc comment and the function/type it documented (handoffTargets, TrackingViolation), orphaning those comments. Cosmetic.
Migration is additive (new table + index, new default settings rows); revert leaves an unused table only. mail.enabled ships false, so a deployment is unchanged until an administrator turns it on.
